description: A society secretary and a waterproofing contractor. A rate per square foot is not the total; the total is agreed at 26,000 and paid as 10,000 before, 10,000 after the first coat and 6,000 at the end; then a parapet is added, bargained 4,000, 3,000, 3,500, agreed, and put into the last payment.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Bablu ji, terrace ki waterproofing ka hisaab bataiye. Neeche wale flat mein seelan aa rahi hai.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Sir chemical coating karenge, do coat. 28 rupaye square foot padta hai, aapki chhat hazaar square foot hai.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Sir 26,000 mein kar deta hoon, material mera.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: 10,000 pehle, 10,000 pehla coat lagne ke baad, aur 6,000 kaam poora hone par.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai, das das aur chhe, chalega.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Sir parapet ki deewar pe bhi crack hai. Woh bhi karna ho to 4,000 extra lagega.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Sir saadhe teen kar dijiye, material bhi lagega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai saadhe teen, kar do. Aakhri payment ke saath de denge.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji sir, to aakhri payment 9,500, pakka. Somvar se shuru.
